title: Leaderboard query: Get user's own rank
description: Create query to get the current user's rank on both leaderboards. Returns position even if user doesn't have displayName (shows 'Set name to appear').

acceptanceCriteria.text: Query accepts visitorId, type (streak/progress), period args
Returns user's rank number and score
Works for users without displayName (calculates rank but won't show on public board)
